overview.value: Eutelsat Group describes itself as a global leader in satellite communications, delivering secure, high-performance multi-orbit connectivity and broadcasting solutions. The company operates a fleet of 31 geostationary satellites combined with a low Earth orbit constellation of more than 600 satellites. Eutelsat Group says it delivers more than 6,400 TV channels to over 1 billion viewers and provides connectivity to businesses and communities worldwide.

focus.value: Multi-orbit satellite connectivity and broadcasting solutions provider
